about: Every intent Sujan has stated for the Catalog OS program. status starts 'failing'; it becomes 'done' only when its end-state test passes. Source: Sujan's messages of 2026-11-02 unless noted.

intents.quote: rethink every single thing ... from first principles
intents.intent: Question every requirement, ground rule, and the operating model against evidence
intents.test: Plan v3 lists each assumption with an evidence verdict

intents.quote: if something already exists today, we can just directly go ahead and reuse it
intents.intent: Buy commodity capabilities (generation, bg removal, upscaling, try-on); build pipeline, eval, learning
intents.test: Each capability has a buy/build verdict backed by a bake-off

intents.quote: we should always have a lot of fallbacks
intents.intent: Every bought capability has 2-3 ranked vendor fallbacks behind one interface
intents.test: Killing the primary vendor in staging still completes a batch

intents.quote: how do we say that this is a great product that actually converts
intents.intent: Measure conversion impact of content changes, pooled and causal, controlling for price, ads, promotions, stock, season
intents.test: First pooled experiment reports lift or no-lift with confidence bounds

intents.quote: you will be acting as more of a manager and delegator
intents.intent: Main session coordinates; subagents do the work; Fable only for critical tasks
intents.test: Every work item has a subagent report in MAIN/.runs

intents.quote: hundreds and thousands of intents ... captured and we get back to it
intents.intent: Keep this ledger complete and current
intents.test: Every Sujan message is parsed into this file

intents.quote: it has to be very clear: Why ... What's the problem ... tech ... product vision
intents.intent: One-page briefs with Problem / Why / Tech / Product vision; ask only critical questions
intents.test: Gate-1 brief fits one page with those four headings

intents.quote: At no point should the user or the operator have cognitive load
intents.intent: World-class design; simple, intuitive, zero babysitting
intents.test: Operator uploads a real batch and walks away; zero required clicks until links are ready

intents.quote: after each step, the person has to wait ... click Next and confirm
intents.intent: Wizard advances by itself; no waiting on steps
intents.test: Batch reaches processing with no Next/confirm after upload

intents.quote: the way of building should not be dependent on another component
intents.intent: Independent modules built in order of business value
intents.test: Module map shows each module shippable alone

intents.quote: This particular product should be launched in a week
intents.intent: Ship the critical value slice fast (GCC fashion first, chosen 2026-11-02)
intents.test: First slice live on a real GCC batch

intents.quote: self-learning and self-evolving ... new models come in
intents.intent: Benchmark harness: new model/vendor scored on our golden sets and promoted automatically if it wins
intents.test: Plugging in a new vendor produces a scored comparison without code changes

intents.quote: take a lot of inspiration from open source as well as close source
intents.intent: Use open source where licence allows; learn from and later beat closed-source leaders
intents.test: Vendor/competitor teardown with licence checks exists

intents.quote: fundamentally think about human in the loop and without the loop
intents.intent: Progress toward no human in the loop; keep only audits, product truth, modesty, likeness rights, threshold changes
intents.test: HITL map documented; no per-SKU review queue in product

intents.quote: reliability is one of the most critical things
intents.intent: Product is reliable end to end
intents.test: Batch success rate and incident count tracked; target set in gate-1 brief

intents.quote: watch @harvey_approach/How-Harvey-Built-SnapYT.App.mp4
intents.intent: Extract Harvey's first-principles method and what applies to us
intents.test: Report in MAIN/.runs on the video

intents.quote: an operator who is doing 2,000 SKUs ... do not even have the time to look at all of these
intents.intent: System resolves issues by rules instead of surfacing per-product attention
intents.test: Batch of 2,000 SKUs produces one digest, not per-SKU cards

intents.quote: such a good image analyzer that it is able to understand every single thing
intents.intent: Universal image analyzer (product, category, shot type, missing shots, colours, attributes, defects); measured per attribute
intents.test: Per-attribute accuracy on golden set reported

intents.quote: all the brands that are there in the GCC today
intents.intent: Census of GCC brands, categories and product types beyond our own data
intents.test: Market census report with taxonomy coverage

intents.quote: we have access to Supabase ... history of all of the products, brands, images
intents.intent: Analyse our full history of brands, products, images, categories
intents.test: Data census report in MAIN/.runs

intents.quote: everything should be configurable in the settings
intents.intent: Non-technical admin can change channel rules, categories, brands, vendors, thresholds
intents.test: Admin changes a channel rule in the UI and the next batch follows it

intents.quote: this part of the process should be fundamentally focused only on ... analyzing
intents.intent: Analysis module separated from acting modules
intents.test: Module map shows analysis as its own module

intents.quote: able to deal with and anticipate any kind of ambiguity
intents.intent: Pipeline handles ambiguous or bad input without stalling
intents.test: Messy real batch completes without operator help

intents.quote: our organic conversions boost significantly ... across all of the channels
intents.intent: North star: organic conversion lift per channel; track per SKU and channel over time
intents.test: Outcome dashboard per channel live

intents.quote: secondary metric ... pricing, the cost, and the time
intents.intent: Track true cost per SKU (vendor + GCP) and generation time
intents.test: Cost meter matches GCP billing within 10%

intents.quote: go to agencies ... sign up other e-commerce brands ... all over the world
intents.intent: Self-serve product for external brands and agencies; onboarding hook for Opptra distribution
intents.test: Vision covered in gate-1 brief

intents.quote: be a little bit more cognizant of the type of questions that you ask me
intents.intent: Ask only questions that truly need a human
intents.test: Ongoing

intents.quote: all of our products ... very much ROI-focused
intents.intent: Every module tied to a measured outcome
intents.test: Each module in map has its outcome metric

intents.quote: revisit the product that is currently live ... look at the logs
intents.intent: Deep audit of live tool, logs, recent batches, broken things
intents.test: Live audit report (done 2026-11-02, first pass)

intents.quote: when somebody uploads two or three folders
intents.intent: Multi-folder and multi-file upload works intuitively
intents.test: Drop 3 folders at once; all grouped correctly

intents.quote: that IAM link, by default, you should just be providing it
intents.intent: Show the sheet-sharing email up front, before paste
intents.test: Email visible with copy button before any paste

intents.quote: I have to review around 308 products
intents.intent: No bulk review; system auto-decides
intents.test: Real batch needs zero reviews outside the audit sample

intents.quote: at least generate some image link and give it to me
intents.intent: Give links for held images immediately; improve later
intents.test: Every product has links when the batch finishes

intents.quote: what additional quota I should be asking for
intents.intent: GCP scaling and quota advice
intents.test: Cost and quota report with exact asks

intents.quote: you go ahead and take a very long time doing the testing
intents.intent: Faster change cycle with tiered tests
intents.test: Typical change verified in under 15 minutes

intents.quote: Every time there's a deployment, there's probably certain downtime
intents.intent: Zero-downtime deploys; batches run during deploys
intents.test: A batch started during a deploy finishes cleanly

intents.quote: images are just one part of it ... keywords, the title, the description, A+ content ... videos
intents.intent: Catalog as a whole: images first, then text, keywords, A+, video, attributes, listing files
intents.test: Module map covers every catalog component

intents.quote: keep learning what's working and what's not working
intents.intent: Learning loop specific to channel x category x product, controlling for price, marketing, ads
intents.test: Learning engine produces pooled estimates per change type

intents.quote: cross-pollination ... keyword that works well ... include that in our infographic
intents.intent: Winning signals propagate across content types
intents.test: A winning keyword updates title, backend terms and infographic in one change set

intents.quote: its own independent tech-enabled service that's self-serve
intents.intent: Catalog OS as a standalone self-serve service; later expand to marketing
intents.test: Vision covered in gate-1 brief

intents.quote: additional_documents ... two other documents
intents.intent: Fold Catalog v2 (Cortina India pilot) and the Cataloging Playbook into the plan
intents.test: Playbook converted to rules data with a conflict list

intents.quote: Our priority is the P2 market
intents.intent: First slice serves GCC fashion; India Cortina next on the same core
intents.test: Confirmed by Sujan 2026-11-02

intents.quote: segment them into what kind of modules, and within that, features. For each feature, we go into the requirements
intents.intent: Plan structure: modules, then features, then requirements per feature, defined top-down
intents.test: Module-feature tree approved, then a requirements doc per feature

intents.quote: Have we done a complete analysis and a complete competitor study?
intents.intent: Complete competitor and market study (visual, listing/PIM, measurement, buyers) before going deep
intents.test: Three competitor reports plus a synthesized feature universe

intents.quote: Assume that right now we don't actually have it ... take an estimate or whatever is publicly available
intents.intent: No Amazon seller data API for now; use our BigQuery data plus public data; add SP-API later
intents.test: Measurement design works without SP-API

intents.quote: Sure, go ahead (billing export)
intents.intent: Enable GCP billing export to BigQuery for exact cost per product
intents.test: Billing export table exists and the cost meter reads it

intents.quote: all the decisions that you need from me are yes
intents.intent: Gate 1 approved 2026-11-02: all 7 brief decisions yes (bg 240+/white Amazon img1; holdout 10-17 Nov; Supabase, ila-pg read, billing export; draft title lengths + HSN format check; crops only on Namshi/Noon until AI stance known; demo Streamoid and Rubick; scrape own listings now)
intents.test: Decisions reflected in requirements docs

intents.quote: Right now, just do the end-to-end planning. For the execution part, I will tell you
intents.intent: Produce full end-to-end plan (requirements per module and feature, build roadmap); execute nothing until Sujan says what to execute
intents.test: Requirements docs for all 13 modules plus roadmap committed
